smallest_supported_claim: In this current-source E4B run, neither the pure-idle request nor the explicit inventory-wield request produced its requested primary/secondary command: the first response was wait_here|idle and the second was look_inventory|equip_gun.
causal_account: The bound native session records Katharina as the actual allied hearer, the accepted natural speech submissions, and separate World pauses which surface the E4B responses. The idle premise did not yield pure idle, because wait_here accompanied it. The inventory-wield premise did not yield wield, because the model selected equip_gun instead. These are model-output divergences; no parser, dispatch, or native-action failure is claimed.
